description: Cloud-based instant messaging platform offering Bot API and MTProto API for building bots and clients.
auth_notes: Bot API uses a token in the URL path (e.g. /bot<token>/METHOD); MTProto API uses api_id, api_hash, and auth keys.
credential_notes: Developers can generate bot tokens instantly and free via @BotFather, and get MTProto API credentials free via my.telegram.org.
api_notes: Extensive API support covering messaging, media, chat administration, payments, inline bots, and updates via webhooks or long polling.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Telegram; community servers exist.
rationale: Telegram provides fully public, free-to-access Bot and MTProto APIs with instant self-serve credential creation, making it ready to use as an agent toolkit.

evidence.note: Describes how bot requests use tokens in the HTTPS URL.
Details how developers obtain api_id and api_hash free of charge via my.telegram.org.
Comprehensive listing of Telegram Bot API methods and types.
